en: Black‑and‑white winter street scene showing the entrance gate of a large institutional complex. Snow covers the ground. Two men in long coats and caps stand by an open gate on the left, while other figures walk along a straight road lined with bare young trees and multi‑storey buildings. A central building with a clock tower stands at the far end of the road. On the right, a corner building with columns and balconies bears the name "Erholungsheim" above the entrance. Signs mounted on the gate pillars read "Reservelazarett Löbau" and list visiting hours.
